## Description

Passenger-car oil filter listed as 93-18-6310. The record carries only the number and the vehicle class; the spec figures are reference, not catalogue-verified. What actually guards the engine is the relief valve at high pressure and the drain-back valve at start-up, not the media alone. We suggest confirming thread pitch, gasket seat and relief opening on the spec sheet, then order against that data rather than the number.
